'''Sando 3''' was an [[YZ 3000 tanker]] used to haul [[Water/Legends|water]] from [[Da Soocha]] to its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Napdu]]. In [[137 ABY]] it was used by [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] in an operation to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] refugees off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
